name: Arabica coffee
summary: The morning ritual is a hot coffee at sunrise, with the town still in cloud. Mang Den grows its own Arabica, sipped while the mist lifts.
origin: Mang Den, where Arabica is grown locally and sold at the weekend market.
howToEat: Take a hot cup at sunrise.
Locally grown Arabica is the cup for a cool, misty morning.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square. Local coffee is sold there with macadamia and red rice.
seoTitle: Coffee in Mang Den — hot sunrise cup, local Arabica
seoDescription: A hot coffee at sunrise in the cloud, and locally grown Arabica as the mist lifts over Mang Den.
